details: Several US financial regulatory agencies, including the Federal Reserve and FinCEN, have issued a proposed rule requiring stablecoin issuers to implement customer identification programs similar to those of traditional banks. This move, part of the GENIUS Act implementation, aims to enhance Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) compliance. The new rules would mandate collecting customer data like names, addresses, and identification numbers before account opening.
title: US Regulators Propose Bank-Like ID Rules for Stablecoin Issuers

details: Digital assets, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, weakened despite calmer equity markets, indicating continued sensitivity to interest-rate expectations and overall risk appetite. The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance, which reinforced expectations that US rates could remain higher for longer, provided little support for cryptocurrencies. Geopolitical relief from a reported US-Iran deal helped ease energy market stress but did not significantly bolster crypto, which underperformed technology and AI-related equities.
title: Digital Assets Decline Amid Hawkish Fed Stance and Geopolitical Relief

details: CME Group has filed a lawsuit against the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) after the federal regulator authorized prediction market Kalshi to offer crypto-style perpetual futures. CME argues that the CFTC's classification of Kalshi's perpetual contracts as traditional futures, rather than swaps, allows these highly leveraged derivatives to bypass stricter federal rules and enter domestic markets with lighter regulatory oversight.
title: CME Group Sues CFTC Over Prediction Market Futures Authorization

details: The United States' M2 money supply has reportedly reached a new all-time high of approximately $22.80 trillion in 2026, increasing by over $400 billion this year. This surge in liquidity has sparked debate on Wall Street and within the crypto industry about where this capital might flow, with some crypto investors speculating that digital assets could see another major rally if sentiment shifts away from traditional markets.
title: Rising US Money Supply Prompts Bitcoin Rally Speculation
